notes_context:
These notes were distilled from earlier work in this repository that passed verification. Follow them unless the code or CHANGELOG.md shows they no longer hold.
- [at-0004] Guard mutations with the draft status check: Mutating invoice operations must first check `invoice.status != "draft"` and raise `BillingError("invalid_state", f"invoice {invoice.id} is {invoice.status}")`, matching `issue_invoice` in `ledgerly/invoice.py`.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0001] Annotate Decimal-returning invoice functions: Public functions in ledgerly/invoice.py that return money values declare an explicit `-> Decimal` return annotation, matching line_total and invoice_total.
  (learned from task E01 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0002] Normalize money via to_money before storing: Convert any incoming amount with `to_money` from `ledgerly.money` before storing it on a model or comparing it; compare against `ZERO` from the same module rather than a literal Decimal.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0003] Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes: Signal domain failures by raising `BillingError(code, detail)` from `ledgerly.errors` with a short snake_case code such as `invalid_state`, `invalid_quantity` or `negative_amount`, and put the offending value in the detail via `repr`.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)

item.title: Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc
item.content: In ledgerly, normalize every incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (see `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`).

candidate.title: Compute periods via floor division
candidate.content: Billing periods are computed as `n = (at - start) // timedelta(days=sub.period_days)` then `start + n * length`, mirroring `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`.
